description: Upgrade VieNeuTTSApp's Audiobook export pipeline for full native BooksReader compatibility: rich EPUB metadata & cover extraction with workspace persistence/legacy fallback, pure-Python ID3v2.4-tagged MP3 chapters with oversize stream-merge and book subfolder layout, Narrated EPUB 3 with Media Overlays (Tier T0) enforcing BooksReader's hard MAX_PARS/MAX_XML_BYTES caps, Single-File M4B Audiobook (Tier T1) via managed ffmpeg with FFMETADATA1 chapters, WebP/GIF cover conversion & configurable AAC bitrate, plus AudiobookTab export menu, cancelExport(), cover thumbnails, and vi/en i18n.
